stories.title: Adopt Audit Log Schema and Append-Only Contract (Align with Brain)
stories.description: Align debug_logger output to a standardized audit schema (timestamp, actor, action_type, tool_name, payload metadata, correlation_id, previous_hash, current_hash) and enforce an append-only contract at the persistence layer (no updates/deletes).
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/infrastructure/debug_logger.py; ASSUMPTION: Brain audit schema exists and is reused; GAP: mapping spec not yet defined

stories.title: Append-Only Logging Engine with Hash Chaining
stories.description: Implement core audit logging engine that generates immutable records with deterministic hash chaining (previous_hash to current_hash), ensuring tamper-evident sequencing and atomic insert-only writes to MongoDB.

stories.title: Audit Instrumentation Across Tooling and Services
stories.description: Instrument tool_router, safety_service, provider_search_service, and clinical_trials_service to emit structured audit events for tool calls, external API usage, and safety triggers, maintaining correlation_id continuity per request.

stories.title: Internal Audit Log Read API with Integrity Verification
stories.description: Implement backend-only read/query interface for audit logs supporting filters (correlation_id, time range, action_type) and optional hash-chain verification to validate log integrity without exposing external endpoints.
stories.evidence: GAP: No existing read/query interface in debug_logger

stories.title: Audit Logging Test Suite and Tamper Detection
stories.description: Extend test_debug_logger to validate append-only enforcement, hash chain continuity, cross-service event coverage, and tamper detection scenarios (e.g., missing or altered records), including integration tests from tool_router through persistence.
